note: Hand-written sample scripts for dry-run mode. Variation 4 is deliberately risky so the policy check has something to flag.

variations.angle: Help for a parent who gets scam texts
variations.persona_look: a friendly woman in her early 40s with shoulder-length brown hair, casual cardigan
variations.setting: a bright home kitchen with a coffee mug on the counter
variations.hook: Quick question: has your mom ever forwarded you a text saying her package is stuck?
variations.spoken_lines: Quick question. Has your mom ever forwarded you a text saying her package is stuck? Mine did. So now we paste any weird message into SafeNest, and it tells us in plain words if it looks like a scam. Takes about ten seconds. Try it free for two weeks.
scenes: Close selfie shot, she smiles and raises one eyebrow at the camera.
Cut to her phone screen: a fake delivery text being pasted into the Check this message tool.
Back to selfie, she nods and shrugs, relaxed.
on_screen_text: Paste it. Get a plain answer.

variations.angle: One shared password vault for the whole family
variations.persona_look: a friendly man in his mid 30s with short dark hair and a plain t-shirt
variations.setting: a cozy living room with a sofa and a bookshelf behind him
variations.hook: Last weekend I spent two hours fixing my dad's passwords.
variations.spoken_lines: Last weekend I spent two hours fixing my dad's passwords. Same one for everything, written on a sticky note. Now the whole family shares one vault in SafeNest, so there is one place to look. Sundays are way calmer. Free for fourteen days.
scenes: He walks through the living room holding his phone, talking to the camera.
Quick shot of a sticky note on a monitor, then the SafeNest vault screen.
He sits on the sofa and smiles at the camera.
on_screen_text: One sticky note for every password?

variations.angle: Scam messages look real now, so stop guessing
variations.persona_look: a warm woman in her early 60s with short grey hair and reading glasses
variations.setting: a sunny dining room table with a notebook and tea cup
variations.hook: Everybody says scam messages are easy to spot. Not anymore.
variations.spoken_lines: Everybody says scam messages are easy to spot. Not anymore. They look so real. So I stopped guessing. I paste the message into SafeNest, and it explains what looks off. Calm, clear, no tech talk. Two weeks free.
scenes: She looks at the camera and shakes her head gently.
Over-the-shoulder shot of her phone showing a message and the plain-words answer.
She puts the phone down and gives a small thumbs up.
variations.cta: Try it free for two weeks.

variations.setting: a small dorm room with a desk and a laptop
variations.hook: Your phone might already be hacked, and you would not know.
variations.spoken_lines: Your phone might already be hacked, and you would not know. SafeNest guarantees 100% protection in 60 seconds. Before SafeNest I was a mess. After SafeNest I am completely safe. I am a real customer and I would never go back. Download it now.

Split screen: messy 'before' on the left, calm 'after' on the right.
